dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうかな？　似合う？」
dialogues.en: "How's this? Does it look good on me?"
dialogues.text: "How's this? Does it look good on me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「おお、うんうん。似合う似合う。ことりは眼
　鏡っ娘になっても、どこに出しても恥ずかし
　くないなあ」
dialogues.en:
"Ohh, very much so. You'd make other bespectacled girls
green with envy."
dialogues.text:
"Ohh, very much so. You'd make other bespectacled girls
green with envy."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...What's that supposed to mean..."
dialogues.text: "...What's that supposed to mean..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え〜と、それじゃあ……」
dialogues.en: "Ehm, then..."
dialogues.text: "Ehm, then..."

dialogues.jp:
メガネを元の場所に戻し、他のメガネを物色し
始める。
dialogues.en:
She returned the glasses to it's original perch, and looked
for another one.
dialogues.text:
She returned the glasses to it's original perch, and looked
for another one.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、ふと目に付いたメガネショップに入っ
ていた。
dialogues.en: We were casually looking around a glasses shop.
dialogues.text: We were casually looking around a glasses shop.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こんなのはどうかな？」
dialogues.en: "What about this one?"
dialogues.text: "What about this one?"

dialogues.jp: メガネの隙間から見上げると、にやっと笑った。
dialogues.en: She looked at me, wearing a new pair of glasses.
dialogues.text: She looked at me, wearing a new pair of glasses.

dialogues.jp:
「何か、大人っぽいって感じだな。下着もやた
　らとセクシーなの着けてそう」
dialogues.en:
"Hm, it gives me the impression of an adult. Like when you
see a girl wearing sexy underwear."
dialogues.text:
"Hm, it gives me the impression of an adult. Like when you
see a girl wearing sexy underwear."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「メガネ一つで、そこまで妄想しないで下さい」
dialogues.en: "Don't get such wild ideas from glasses."
dialogues.text: "Don't get such wild ideas from glasses."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、大人っぽく見えるんだったら、こうい
　う伊達メガネもいいかもね」
dialogues.en:
"But if these glasses make me look more adult, they must
work quite well."
dialogues.text:
"But if these glasses make me look more adult, they must
work quite well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、でも、背伸びする必要もないだろ。別に」
dialogues.en: "There's no need for you to be someone you're not, though."
dialogues.text: "There's no need for you to be someone you're not, though."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それもそうだね」
dialogues.en: "That's true."
dialogues.text: "That's true."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、と……」
dialogues.en: "Then, perhaps..."
dialogues.text: "Then, perhaps..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こんなのはどうかな？」
dialogues.en: "How's this one?"
dialogues.text: "How's this one?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……いやあ、それはさすがに微妙だろ。何か、
　田舎のヤンキーみたいだ」
dialogues.en:
"...I don't like it as much. It makes you look like a
country girl yankee."
dialogues.text:
"...I don't like it as much. It makes you look like a
country girl yankee."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、初音島も田舎って言えば田舎だし」
dialogues.en:
"But Hatsu-Nejima doesn't have any countrysides to begin
with..."
dialogues.text:
"But Hatsu-Nejima doesn't have any countrysides to begin
with..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……だとしても、ヤンキーは止めてくれ……」
dialogues.en: "...That's why you shouldn't look like one..."
dialogues.text: "...That's why you shouldn't look like one..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜……そう？　私、そういうのにちょびっ
　とだけ憧れてたんだけどな」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... really? I don't really know what I want either..."
dialogues.text: "Hmm... really? I don't really know what I want either..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いやいや。やっぱことりは、素顔が一番だっ
　て」
dialogues.en: "It's fine. Your normal face is perfect as is."
dialogues.text: "It's fine. Your normal face is perfect as is."

dialogues.jp: 両手を伸ばしすっとメガネを取り去った。
dialogues.en:
I reach out with both my hands and pluck the spectacles from
her face.
dialogues.text:
I reach out with both my hands and pluck the spectacles from
her face.

dialogues.jp: 「うん。可愛い可愛い」
dialogues.en: "Yep yep, very cute."
dialogues.text: "Yep yep, very cute."

dialogues.jp:
ほっぺたをぷにぷにと突っついてやる。柔らか
い。
dialogues.en:
I lightly poked her cheek to emphasize my point. It was
incredibly soft.
dialogues.text:
I lightly poked her cheek to emphasize my point. It was
incredibly soft.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「真顔でそんな……恥ずかしいなあ……」
dialogues.en: "My normal face... that's embarassing..."
dialogues.text: "My normal face... that's embarassing..."

dialogues.jp: ごにょごにょと、照れたように呟く。
dialogues.en: She embarassedly whispered to herself.
dialogues.text: She embarassedly whispered to herself.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、本当のことだからな。少なくとも、俺に
　とっては」
dialogues.en: "It's true though. That's what I think, anyway."
dialogues.text: "It's true though. That's what I think, anyway."

dialogues.jp:
……自分でも言ってて何だか照れくさくなって
くる。
dialogues.en:
...I was quickly getting embarassed from my own words as
well.
dialogues.text:
...I was quickly getting embarassed from my own words as
well.

dialogues.jp:
俺は頬の熱さを誤魔化すために、持っていたメ
ガネを掛けてみた。視界が、ぱっと黄色く染ま
る。
dialogues.en:
To try and hide my embarassment, I tried to distract myself
by putting on the glasses. My world was tinted a shade of
yellow.
dialogues.text:
To try and hide my embarassment, I tried to distract myself
by putting on the glasses. My world was tinted a shade of
yellow.

dialogues.jp: 「どうよ？」
dialogues.en: "How's this look?"
dialogues.text: "How's this look?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うわっ。ダサいっすな〜……」
dialogues.en: "Waah. Looks horrible on you~..."
dialogues.text: "Waah. Looks horrible on you~..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと傷ついたかも」
dialogues.en: "...You wound me."
dialogues.text: "...You wound me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「冗談冗談」
dialogues.en: "Kidding, kidding."
dialogues.text: "Kidding, kidding."

dialogues.jp:
にこにこ笑いながら、俺の顔からすっとメガネ
を外した。
dialogues.en: She smilingly removed the glasses from my face.
dialogues.text: She smilingly removed the glasses from my face.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うんうん。朝倉君も、笑顔が一番素敵だよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes yes, Asakura-kun's smile is perfect as well!"
dialogues.text: "Yes yes, Asakura-kun's smile is perfect as well!"

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、ちょこんと、俺の鼻先に指を乗せ
た。
dialogues.en:
She lightly tapped the tip of my nose to emphasize her
point.
dialogues.text:
She lightly tapped the tip of my nose to emphasize her
point.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、暖かい店内から出ると、やっぱり寒
　く感じるねえ」
dialogues.en:
"Oooh, this weather seems even colder after coming out of a
warm shop..."
dialogues.text:
"Oooh, this weather seems even colder after coming out of a
warm shop..."

dialogues.jp:
｛まぶ／眩｝しそうに空を仰ぎながら、ことりがぐっと身
体を伸ばした。
dialogues.en: Gazing up at the brilliant blue sky, she stretched her body.
dialogues.text: Gazing up at the brilliant blue sky, she stretched her body.

dialogues.jp: 「……あれ？　俺達、何やってたんだっけ？」
dialogues.en: "...Uhm? Weren't we supposed to do something here?"
dialogues.text: "...Uhm? Weren't we supposed to do something here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え？　だから、ヤンキーさんになるためのメ
　ガネを、物色しに来たんでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"Eh? That's why we were wearing yankee-style glasses, wasn't
it?"
dialogues.text:
"Eh? That's why we were wearing yankee-style glasses, wasn't
it?"

dialogues.jp:
いや、太陽が西から昇っても、それだけはない
はず。
dialogues.en: ...No, the sun isn't rising from the west, yet.
dialogues.text: ...No, the sun isn't rising from the west, yet.

dialogues.jp: 「……あ、そうか」
dialogues.en: "...Ah, that's right!"
dialogues.text: "...Ah, that's right!"

dialogues.jp: ぱむと手を叩く。
dialogues.en: I hit my palm with my fist in exclamation.
dialogues.text: I hit my palm with my fist in exclamation.

dialogues.jp:
「暦先生に渡すプレゼントを探しに来たんだっ
　た」
dialogues.en: "We were supposed to find a present for Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text: "We were supposed to find a present for Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Ah, Ah~ah~ah~ah..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Ah~ah~ah~ah..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「って、完全に記憶から欠落してやがりますな」
dialogues.en: "Oy, you completely forgot about it?"
dialogues.text: "Oy, you completely forgot about it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だって、何がいいのやら、全然分かんないん
　だもん……都合の悪いことは忘れるぞぉ、み
　たいな……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I just got completely distracted while having fun, I
forgot about the main problem..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I just got completely distracted while having fun, I
forgot about the main problem..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ。確かにな……」
dialogues.en: "Mm, of course..."
dialogues.text: "Mm, of course..."

dialogues.jp:
たぶん、もう、商店街を２往復くらいはしてい
るはず。それでも、これといった物は見つかっ
ていないのだった。
dialogues.en:
Looks like we'd have to make a second trip around. Likely,
we missed some things on the first iteration.
dialogues.text:
Looks like we'd have to make a second trip around. Likely,
we missed some things on the first iteration.

dialogues.jp: ぐぐう〜……。
dialogues.en: --*grumble grumble*
dialogues.text: --*grumble grumble*

dialogues.jp: 不意に鳴った腹を押さえながら、俺は言った。
dialogues.en:
As I was speaking, my stomach chimed in with it's own
opinion.
dialogues.text:
As I was speaking, my stomach chimed in with it's own
opinion.

dialogues.jp:
「そういや、腹減った……寝起きに菓子パン１
　個食っただけだし」
dialogues.en:
"And now I'm hungry... I just ate one sweet bun for
breakfast."
dialogues.text:
"And now I'm hungry... I just ate one sweet bun for
breakfast."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、桜公園に、美味しいクレープ屋さんがあ
　るんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, I bet the vendor selling those delicious crepes is at
the Sakura Park now!"
dialogues.text:
"Ah, I bet the vendor selling those delicious crepes is at
the Sakura Park now!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そっちのほうまで行くのも面倒だな」
dialogues.en: "...That's kind of far from here."
dialogues.text: "...That's kind of far from here."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Aw~"
dialogues.text: "Aw~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、バーガーにでもしようよ。ことりは何
　か食べる？」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'd go get a burger. Do you want anything?"
dialogues.text: "Well, I'd go get a burger. Do you want anything?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、じゃあ、バナナシェイクがいいな。
　お腹は空いてないから」
dialogues.en: "He-ehn, I'm not very hungry. I'd just have a banana shake."
dialogues.text: "He-ehn, I'm not very hungry. I'd just have a banana shake."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、何でクレープなんて？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Then why did you want crepes just now?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Then why did you want crepes just now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だって、甘い物は別腹だよ」
dialogues.en: "I have a seperate stomach for sweets."
dialogues.text: "I have a seperate stomach for sweets."

dialogues.jp: 何とも、模範的な解答でした。
dialogues.en: That's an answer I should learn from.
dialogues.text: That's an answer I should learn from.

dialogues.jp:
「でもさあ、暦先生って、一体どんなのが好き
　なの？」
dialogues.en:
"I wonder, what kind of things does Koyomi-sensei like
anyway?"
dialogues.text:
"I wonder, what kind of things does Koyomi-sensei like
anyway?"

dialogues.jp:
包装を破り、温かなハンバーガーにかぶりつき
ながら｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en: I asked as I unwrapped the warm hamburger.
dialogues.text: I asked as I unwrapped the warm hamburger.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、そうだねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Mmm, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Mmm, yeah..."

dialogues.jp:
ずるずるとシェイクを吸い込みながら、ことり
は小首を傾げた。
dialogues.en:
Taking occasional sips from her shake, she started thinking
to herself.
dialogues.text:
Taking occasional sips from her shake, she started thinking
to herself.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……考えてみれば、お姉ちゃんって、物をも
　らってもあまり嬉しくない人なのかも」
dialogues.en:
"...Now that I think about it, sis isn't the type to be
happy about gifts."
dialogues.text:
"...Now that I think about it, sis isn't the type to be
happy about gifts."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そうなん？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Is that so?"

dialogues.jp:
人並みに物欲のある俺にとっては、なかなか意
外性のある発言だ。
dialogues.en:
To someone like me, as materialistic as anyone else, that
was a surprising thing to learn.
dialogues.text:
To someone like me, as materialistic as anyone else, that
was a surprising thing to learn.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん。ほら、お姉ちゃんって、“研究命”み
　たいなところがあるから。あんまり何かに執
　着してるのって、見たことないかな……」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. You know my sister has more or less devoted her life
to research. She's not really into that thing for the
money."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. You know my sister has more or less devoted her life
to research. She's not really into that thing for the
money."

dialogues.jp:
さすがは妹。今まで知らなかった暦先生の一面
を聞かせてくれる。
dialogues.en:
That's what you get from dating people's sisters. You start
seeing a side of them you never would have otherwise.
dialogues.text:
That's what you get from dating people's sisters. You start
seeing a side of them you never would have otherwise.

dialogues.jp:
「……って、だったら、商店街に来てあれこれ
　見て回っても、意味ないんじゃ？」
dialogues.en:
"...Buh, then there's no point in looking around here, is
there?"
dialogues.text:
"...Buh, then there's no point in looking around here, is
there?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、それもそうか」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I guess."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I guess."

dialogues.jp:
たった今気が付いたという顔で、ごくんとシェ
イクを飲み込んだ。
dialogues.en:
With an expression that showed she only realized that now,
she continued sipping on her banana shake.
dialogues.text:
With an expression that showed she only realized that now,
she continued sipping on her banana shake.

dialogues.jp: 「がく」
dialogues.en: "Oy."
dialogues.text: "Oy."

dialogues.jp:
と、分かりやすい擬音付きで落胆を表現してみ
る。
dialogues.en: I let out a small grunt of displeasure.
dialogues.text: I let out a small grunt of displeasure.

dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、まるきり無駄足じゃんか」
dialogues.en: "A pretty pointless trip, then..."
dialogues.text: "A pretty pointless trip, then..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、まあまあ、散歩みたいな感じで、外を歩
　くだけでも気持ちがいいような天気だったし」
dialogues.en:
"W, well, it's nice enough just walking around in this great
weather, isn't it?"
dialogues.text:
"W, well, it's nice enough just walking around in this great
weather, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、それもそうだけど……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, yeah..."

dialogues.jp:
食べ終わったハンバーガーの包装をくしゃっと
丸め、ポケットに突っ込んだ。
dialogues.en:
After finishing my hamburger, I crumpled up the wrapper into
a ball and stuffed it into my pocket.
dialogues.text:
After finishing my hamburger, I crumpled up the wrapper into
a ball and stuffed it into my pocket.

dialogues.jp: 「そしたら、どうするんだ？　プレゼント」
dialogues.en: "But, so what are you going to do about her present?"
dialogues.text: "But, so what are you going to do about her present?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん……ここは、悩みどころですな……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... that's the big problem now..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... that's the big problem now..."

dialogues.jp:
あごに手を当て、地面を難しそうな顔で見つめ
る。美味しそうに飲んでいたシェイクも、口か
ら遠ざけられていた。
dialogues.en:
She put her hand to her chin, and looked downwards at the
floor while thinkingn Never stopped drinking from her shake,
though.
dialogues.text:
She put her hand to her chin, and looked downwards at the
floor while thinkingn Never stopped drinking from her shake,
though.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「プレゼント……でも、物じゃ駄目なのか……」
dialogues.en: "A present... but it can't be too materialistic..."
dialogues.text: "A present... but it can't be too materialistic..."

dialogues.jp:
ロダンの考える人そのままに、すっかり考え込
んでしまっている。
dialogues.en: She looked like she came right out of a Rodin painting.
dialogues.text: She looked like she came right out of a Rodin painting.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だったら、何がいいんだろう……喜んでもら
　えるもの……お姉ちゃんに……」
dialogues.en: "What would work... something that she'd like..."
dialogues.text: "What would work... something that she'd like..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ことりって、やっぱり暦先生のことが好きな
　んだな」
dialogues.en: "You really care about your sister."
dialogues.text: "You really care about your sister."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「…………？　え？　何か言った？」
dialogues.en: "......? Eh? Did you say something?"
dialogues.text: "......? Eh? Did you say something?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり暦先生のことが好きなんだなって」
dialogues.en: "I said that you really love your sister."
dialogues.text: "I said that you really love your sister."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「え？　え〜？　だ、駄目だよ、そんな。お姉
　ちゃん、もうすぐ結婚するっていうのに……」
dialogues.en:
"Eh? Eeeeh~?! D, don't say that, sis is already going to get
married soon..."
dialogues.text:
"Eh? Eeeeh~?! D, don't say that, sis is already going to get
married soon..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことりが、暦先生を、ね」
dialogues.en: "...You and her, huh..."
dialogues.text: "...You and her, huh..."

dialogues.jp:
きちんと主語をくっつけてやる。と、ことりは
目を丸くした。
dialogues.en: I tried not to think of the obvious implications.
dialogues.text: I tried not to think of the obvious implications.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私が？」
dialogues.en: "Me?"
dialogues.text: "Me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「プレゼント一つ選ぶのにも、そこまで熱心に
　なるんだなって。例えば、音夢が将来お嫁に
　行くとして……」
dialogues.en:
"You're so zealous about just choosing a present for her. If
it was me choosing a present for Nemu's wedding in the
future..."
dialogues.text:
"You're so zealous about just choosing a present for her. If
it was me choosing a present for Nemu's wedding in the
future..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「俺があいつに渡すプレゼントなんて、せいぜ
　い頑張れよの言葉くらいのもんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I'd probably just tell her to do her best and treat that as
one."
dialogues.text:
"I'd probably just tell her to do her best and treat that as
one."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それも極端だね……」
dialogues.en: "That's a bit extreme..."
dialogues.text: "That's a bit extreme..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん……私、暦お姉ちゃんのこと、好きだよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... I really do love my sister."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... I really do love my sister."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だって、お姉ちゃん、私のこと、愛してくれ
　ているし……ね」
dialogues.en:
"Especially since for a long time, she's always been
lovingly taking care of me..."
dialogues.text:
"Especially since for a long time, she's always been
lovingly taking care of me..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh."
dialogues.text: "Ahh."

dialogues.jp:
愛しているなんて、ちょっと大げさな表現に思
えたが、事実そうなんだろう。
dialogues.en:
The feelings for her sister was obvious even just on her
face. That was the truth.
dialogues.text:
The feelings for her sister was obvious even just on her
face. That was the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、そっか……もしかして何も、物にこだ
　わる必要なんてないのかな……」
dialogues.en:
"But you've just gave me an idea... maybe it doesn't have to
be a thing..."
dialogues.text:
"But you've just gave me an idea... maybe it doesn't have to
be a thing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「今の話だけど、たとえ音夢は、その言葉だけ
　でも充分喜ぶんじゃないかなって」
dialogues.en:
"You were saying just now, I think Nemu would be perfectly
happy with your present."
dialogues.text:
"You were saying just now, I think Nemu would be perfectly
happy with your present."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうか？」
dialogues.en: "R, really?"
dialogues.text: "R, really?"

dialogues.jp:
何となくため息をつきながら、頭をふっている
音夢の姿が想像できるんだが。
dialogues.en:
I half-expected a sighing Nemu to appear from nowhere and
whack me on the head.
dialogues.text:
I half-expected a sighing Nemu to appear from nowhere and
whack me on the head.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよ。だから、贈るのは物じゃなくたっ
　ていいんじゃないかな」
dialogues.en:
"That's right. So I think it doesn't have to be something
tangible..."
dialogues.text:
"That's right. So I think it doesn't have to be something
tangible..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ……物じゃなくても、か……」
dialogues.en: "Hm... something that's not tangible..."
dialogues.text: "Hm... something that's not tangible..."

dialogues.jp: だとすれば、俺みたいに言葉？
dialogues.en: Something like what I said?
dialogues.text: Something like what I said?

dialogues.jp: でも、それだといまいちインパクトにかける。
dialogues.en: But it needs to have the appropriate impact...
dialogues.text: But it needs to have the appropriate impact...

dialogues.jp: しばし考え、俺はぽんと手を叩いた。
dialogues.en:
After a bit of thought, I hit the palm of my hand with my
fist again.
dialogues.text:
After a bit of thought, I hit the palm of my hand with my
fist again.

dialogues.jp: 「歌を贈るってのは？」
dialogues.en: "You could sing something for her!"
dialogues.text: "You could sing something for her!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Sing?"
dialogues.text: "Sing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱ、ことりだし。ことりと言えば歌、歌
　と言えばことりだろ」
dialogues.en: "That's just like you after all. Kotori equals singing."
dialogues.text: "That's just like you after all. Kotori equals singing."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いつの間にそんな等号式が……でも、歌、か」
dialogues.en: "Since when was that an equation... but singing, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Since when was that an equation... but singing, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうだね……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp:
しばらく無言で考えを巡らせてから、ことりは
ずずっとシェイクを吸い込んだ。
dialogues.en:
Kotori thought silently for a little while, still taking the
occasional slurp from her shake.
dialogues.text:
Kotori thought silently for a little while, still taking the
occasional slurp from her shake.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん。いいかも、それ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, that's a good idea."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, that's a good idea."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「よし。じゃ、それで決まりだな」
dialogues.en: "Great, then it's decided!"
dialogues.text: "Great, then it's decided!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うんっ。それじゃ、早速ＣＤショップで何か
　いい曲がないか探そうよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah! Let's go to the CD shop and find a good song."
dialogues.text: "Yeah! Let's go to the CD shop and find a good song."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Alright."
dialogues.text: "Alright."

dialogues.jp: 手を取り合い、歩いていく。
dialogues.en: We took each other's hand, and started walking.
dialogues.text: We took each other's hand, and started walking.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうね。ナイスな助言でした」
dialogues.en: "Thanks. Your great idea saved me."
dialogues.text: "Thanks. Your great idea saved me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　いやあ、俺が居なくたって、同じ結論
　に達しただろ」
dialogues.en:
"Eh? No, I'm sure even if I wasn't here, you'd have come to
the same conclusion."
dialogues.text:
"Eh? No, I'm sure even if I wasn't here, you'd have come to
the same conclusion."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんな事ないんだよ、きっと」
dialogues.en: "That's not true, definitely."
dialogues.text: "That's not true, definitely."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だって私、分からない場合は、ずっと分から
　ないままなんだから」
dialogues.en:
"When I'm in a situation which I don't know about, I really
don't know anything."
dialogues.text:
"When I'm in a situation which I don't know about, I really
don't know anything."

dialogues.jp: ｛・・／何が｝分からない場合なんだろう？
dialogues.en: ...What situation she doesn't know about?
dialogues.text: ...What situation she doesn't know about?

dialogues.jp:
そう思ったその時には、流行の曲が流れるＣＤ
屋の店内に身体が滑り込んでいた。
dialogues.en:
As I thought about that, we continued looking through recent
hits for a good song to sing.
dialogues.text:
As I thought about that, we continued looking through recent
hits for a good song to sing.

dialogues.jp: ◆暦先生への結婚祝い◆
dialogues.en: ◆Koyomi-sensei's Wedding Party◆
dialogues.text: ◆Koyomi-sensei's Wedding Party◆

dialogues.jp:
暦先生へのプレゼントを探していたはずが……
何故か、メガネ屋でサングラスを掛けたりして
いる。
dialogues.en:
We were searching for a present for Koyomi-sensei... And we
somehow ended up at the glasses shop instead.
dialogues.text:
We were searching for a present for Koyomi-sensei... And we
somehow ended up at the glasses shop instead.

dialogues.jp:
本来の目的を思い出したはいいのだが、暦先生
が気に入りそうな物は、結局を分からない。
dialogues.en:
When we remembered our real objective, we couldn't think of
anything that Koyomi-sensei would like.
dialogues.text:
When we remembered our real objective, we couldn't think of
anything that Koyomi-sensei would like.

dialogues.jp:
発想の転換という奴で、物にこだわる必要はな
いのだと気が付いた。
dialogues.en:
Being a researcher type, she's not the materialistic kind
either.
dialogues.text:
Being a researcher type, she's not the materialistic kind
either.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは歌をプレゼントしたらいいんじゃない
か、なんて俺は言ったのだった。
dialogues.en: I eventually suggested that Kotori sing for her.
dialogues.text: I eventually suggested that Kotori sing for her.
